reasoning_content: Let me check the template contents (composer.json) to understand the primary install method.

action.command: cd /tmp; apt-get install -y unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; unzip -o template.zip -d template_extract 2>&1 | tail -3; find template_extract -maxdepth 2 -name composer.json; echo "=== composer.json ==="; cat template_extract/*/composer.json 2>/dev/null | head -60
